text:
Eleni: FYI inbound from UK held at EU border - missing CE declaration triggered secondary inspection. AWB UK->FRA: UKF-55500011. PO RDW-76090. Vendor offered two options: (A) reroute to AMS cross-dock for reprovisioning & docs fix + fast-track (~€6k, ETA ~48h) OR (B) return to origin for corrected docs (~7d). Need sign-off. :thinking:

Mark (NordFreight): Confirmed hold. Secondary flagged missing CE/DoC paperwork. AMS crossdock workflow: we can clear under bonded transit, reissue docs, repackage, and run a preflight firmware parity check on 10 units while there. Crossdock fee estimate €6,100 incl handling. Return-to-origin cost ~€2k but +7d delay and reconsignment risk.

Priya: Finance prefers return but infra wants some units faster. Can we hybrid: crossdock 4 priority units, return rest? Price break?

Mark (NordFreight): Hybrid OK. Crossdock for 4 units = €3,200 (incl rush). Return remaining at €1,400. Total ~€4,600. Need PO amendment to proceed.

Eleni: Do we get SN continuity? Our asset tracker fails if mixed batches non-contiguous. Also one unit flagged by manifest as possible firmware v mismatch (vendor notes received v3.4 vs expected v3.5). That could cause provisioning failures. What's vendor plan?

Mark (NordFreight): SNs we move by air/crossdock will be contiguous: H100-UK-3001..3004. Return batch SNs H100-UK-3005..3020. For firmware: we can run a reimage at AMS for the 4 expedited units (adds €120/unit) or vendor can supply signed boot-image and tag for on-site flash after arrival. Reimage at AMS reduces chance of DOA.

Devon: Ops: if we accept crossdock + reimage, require depot QC hold in FRA: photos, serial reconciliation, 15m burn-in, POST. Also pre-open RMA for any DOA to speed replacements. Do not let provisioner auto-assign serials until verification.

ops-bot: Created task `task-76090-ams-crossdock-qc` assigned to @Devon. Checklist: pickup photos, serial reconciliation, reflash log, 15m burn-in, POST, dmesg.

RMA-bot: Precreated RMA RMA-76090-01 for inbound lot. Prepaid labels attached pending arrival.

Sam: Infra note : AMS crossdock min lead for KMS injection slot is 36h once unit in our cage. Physical install still ~48-72h. Tag cost center INFRA-APAC? (no, EU) -> INFRA-EU. Update procurement coding.

Priya: Approve hybrid at €4,600 plus reimage €480 for 4 units (total €5,080). Charge to INFRA-EU. Send amendment to procurement@redwood.ai and customs@redwood.ai.

Mark (NordFreight): Amendment sent to Eleni. Proforma attached. Will dispatch crossdock pull on sign. AWB for crossdock move ABN-333444555. Carrier will send pickup photos and reimage logs.

Eleni: Thanks. Once crossdock done, ops please upload reflash logs to task and ping infra for KMS slot. Closing thread until updates. :white_check_mark:
